description: Ettin (two-headed giant), body 2 (0x02), classic MUL, unarmed. Monster action group (22 slots, 13 present). Placement, directions and projection as the human bodies; the canvas is wider and taller because the Ettin is ~2.2x human height and its deaths reach 130 px sideways. Body 18 is the same creature holding an axe.

canvas.notes: A frame's ground origin (encoded center cx, height+cy from its top-left) lands on the anchor. Measured extents over all actions and stored directions: x -130..+129, y -146..+60 around the origin. Mirroring: pixel column i -> 319 - i, joint x -> 319 - x.

blender.notes: Source frame f is keyed at Blender frame 1 + 4f. Playback timing is not inferred from the animation files.
